name: nif_script_root_renames
title: Authored root names survive model mirror publication

steps.query:
array_var roots
string_var rootName
float ok
Begin Function { }
let roots := player.GetChildBlocks "" 2
let rootName := roots[0]
let ok := player.RenameNifBlock rootName "NVFScriptFirstRoot" 2
PrintC "nvf root first rename %g" ok
SetFunctionValue ok
End
steps.label: first.rename

steps.query:
array_var roots
float comparison
Begin Function { }
let roots := player.GetChildBlocks "" 2
let comparison := sv_Compare roots[0] "NVFScriptFirstRoot"
PrintC "nvf root first kept %g" (comparison == 0)
SetFunctionValue (comparison == 0)
End
steps.label: first.kept

steps.query:
array_var roots
string_var rootName
float ok
Begin Function { }
let roots := player.GetChildBlocks "" 1
let rootName := roots[0]
let ok := player.RenameNifBlock rootName "NVFScriptThirdRoot" 1
PrintC "nvf root third rename %g" ok
SetFunctionValue ok
End
steps.label: third.rename

steps.query:
array_var roots
float firstComparison
float thirdComparison
Begin Function { }
let roots := player.GetChildBlocks "" 2
let firstComparison := sv_Compare roots[0] "NVFScriptFirstRoot"
let roots := player.GetChildBlocks "" 1
let thirdComparison := sv_Compare roots[0] "NVFScriptThirdRoot"
PrintC "nvf root first still kept %g" (firstComparison == 0)
PrintC "nvf root third kept %g" (thirdComparison == 0)
SetFunctionValue ((firstComparison == 0) && (thirdComparison == 0))
End
steps.label: both.kept
